### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately attribute durations to specific symptoms as explicitly stated by the patient; do not infer or extend durations from one symptom to another.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[P-Section]: Strictly link diagnostic orders and urgent care recommendations to the specific conditions or symptoms explicitly stated by the provider; do not re-associate or infer new triggers. Include only explicit instructions, recommendations, or plans stated by the provider; avoid inferring general medical practices or implied next steps.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[P-Section]: When detailing follow-up plans, report only the specific appointments or contingencies explicitly stated by the provider; do not generalize into 'as needed' or open-ended plans.
